chunks: And what will make you comprehend what the startling calamity is?

key_terms.أَدْرَاكَ: You will comprehend/understand, indicating deep knowledge or realization.
key_terms.الْقَارِعَةُ: The Striking Calamity, referring to the Day of Judgment or the Hour that strikes people with awe and terror.

ai.seo_question: What is the Qari'ah and what does it signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question highlights the inadequacy of human intellect to fully grasp the severity of the 'Qari'ah', often interpreted as the sudden, striking calamity of the Day of Judgment or the specific upheaval of the Hour. It serves to instill awe and prepare the believer for the subsequent description of the weighing of deeds, emphasizing that no worldly knowledge can suffice to comprehend the magnitude of divine retribution.
